title: Biased probability of a negative output
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The biased minus probability of $f$ is the expectation, under the product distribution on sign vectors with bias parameter $p$, of the indicator that $f(x)=-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to signs
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the biased product distribution or the convention for its bias parameter.
